public.text: The national digital architect is given authority to define standards, evaluate conformance, enforce coordination and say no or escalate. The guidance does not require countries to document which decisions the architect holds, where escalation runs, the criteria for an architectural objection, or what is recorded when an objection is overridden. Section 3.4.4 provides a useful model by requiring explicit triggers and documented, time-bound escalation for operational governance.
public.suggestedRevision: Require each country to publish a decision-rights statement for the national digital architect: decisions held outright, decisions on which the architect advises, escalation routes and trigger conditions, and the decision record required when an architectural objection is overridden. The institutional route may remain country-specific.
